context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 52 verified the Pay-to-Activate Partner feature. All backend endpoints working correctly. Webhook router was missing from api_router - this has been fixed. Frontend components (SellOptionsModal, CreateListingPage, CreateMultiItemListing, PartnerManager) all have correct platform_fee_paid checks and lockdown UI. The Stripe integration uses real live keys ($100 CAD/year recurring subscription). To fully test, create a pending partner application via /api/partner/apply, then verify via admin, which will create a real Stripe checkout. Partner accounts with is_partner=true and platform_fee_paid=false will see lockdown UI and be blocked from creating listings.
